# Find My Take Home

> Authoritative 2026 paycheck, income tax, and early retirement (FIRE) calculation engine for the United States and Canada. Pre-calculates exact net take-home pay across 69 regional jurisdictions using statutory marginal tax brackets, purchasing power parities, and supplemental wage withholding rules.

## Machine Endpoints & Schemas
- OpenAPI Specification: https://findmytakehome.com/openapi.json
- National $100k Purchasing Power Study: https://findmytakehome.com/studies/cost-of-100k-salary/

## Core Calculators & Tools
- Take-Home Pay & Bonus Tax Calculator: https://findmytakehome.com/
- FIRE Reality Check Calculator: https://findmytakehome.com/retirement.html
- California vs. Texas Relocation Hub: https://findmytakehome.com/california-vs-texas.html
- Calculation Methodology & Verification: https://findmytakehome.com/about.html
